lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Build a creative website that walks people through how this team works.

lines.speaker: pm
lines.text: Got it. I'll write that down, add what I think success looks like, and list what I'll need you to decide. You'll see it again at Gate 1.

lines.speaker: pm
lines.text: Opening projects/how-it-works/. Brief first. Then Research.

lines.speaker: pm
lines.text: New project: a site that explains how we work. Research leads. Everyone else: read the brief and tell me now if anything worries you.

lines.speaker: research
lines.text: On it. I'll start with who would actually read this.

lines.speaker: concept
lines.text: Nothing to draw yet. I'll warm up the GPU anyway.

lines.speaker: frontend
lines.text: When you have a content shape, send it to me before you write it down. I'd rather argue early.

lines.speaker: backend
lines.text: Deal. You'll get a draft contract before anything's frozen.

lines.speaker: review
lines.text: I'll be reading. Don't wait for me to be nice.

lines.speaker: research
lines.text: DONE 01-research-discover. Eight competitors, three personas, twenty references, every claim cited. The headline: nobody who sells AI design shows their own process end to end.

lines.speaker: pm
lines.text: So the site should.

lines.speaker: research
lines.text: The site should be the process. Follow its own sentence from the first line to launch.

lines.speaker: backend
lines.text: Stack proposal's in: static Astro, no client framework, every image licence-checked at build. Nothing runs on a server: the whole site is built ahead of time.

lines.speaker: review
lines.text: Revise before it goes to the human. Two questions have options the packet doesn't letter, and one recommendation hides a trade-off.

lines.speaker: pm
lines.text: Fixed both. Re-check?

lines.speaker: review
lines.text: Pass. Send it.

lines.speaker: concept
lines.text: Three directions ready. A is a paper trail. B is a signal path. C is a marble run on a sunflower-yellow wall. Each has key art made on the local GPU, and every image has its prompt and licence beside it.

lines.speaker: review
lines.text: Licence walk is clean: no non-commercial model anywhere in any image's history. C's hero shows a dozen clay figures; the cast is six. Fix that before the human sees it.

lines.speaker: concept
lines.text: Six figures. Counted twice.

lines.speaker: frontend
lines.text: Three worktrees, three branches, three dev servers on 4321, 4322 and 4323. Building them side by side so none of them gets my best idea by accident.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: npx impeccable detect web/src  →  0 findings

lines.speaker: frontend
lines.text: All three screenshotted at four widths. Contact sheet's in the packet. C is the most fun and the hardest to read on a phone; I've said so in its hypothesis.

lines.speaker: review
lines.text: REVISE. Three findings. Focus is hidden under the sticky rail on chapter 6; two buttons fail contrast in dark mode; the credits page is missing one licence.

lines.speaker: frontend
lines.text: Focus and contrast are mine. Fixed.

lines.speaker: backend
lines.text: Licence is mine. Added, and the build now fails if it's ever missing again.

lines.speaker: review
lines.text: PASS. Ready for the human.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Set up the website building team from BOOTSTRAP.md.

lines.speaker: pm
lines.text: Checking your machine first. Then I'll set up the tools, open five threads, and ask what you'd like to build.
